tools.name: create_ad
tools.description: Starts building a free watermarked 15-second video ad from a public web page, in the language of that page. Use it when the user asks for a video ad for their site, product, app or store. The address must be the user's own, given by them in this conversation: never guess it or use someone else's. It

tools.name: get_ad_status
tools.description: Returns the state of an ad started with create_ad: building, preview_ready, paid, failed or unavailable, with its page link, the changes left and the reason for a failure. Use it when the user asks whether their ad is ready, or before saying that it is. To wait for an ad being built, pass wait_secon

tools.name: request_change
tools.description: Rebuilds an existing ad with a change the user asked for, such as other wording, colors or images. It uses up one of the changes left, and one free change is included, so call it only when the user asked for this change, and pass their request as they said it.
